cause.label: equity_offering
cause.what_happened: On 2026-10-05 YYForce entered a $20m at-the-market sales agreement with Spartan Capital (6-K plus 424B5 at a $1.46 reference price). The stock has fallen on each session since: about -5.5% on 10-05, -18.1% on 10-06, and -11.5% to $1.00 by 15:05 ET on 10-07, the last two on ordinary volume. No 6-K or news was found for 10-06 or 10-07.

findings.finding: The $20m Spartan Capital ATM entered on 2026-10-05 is live and can sell Class A shares into the 2026-10-08 session. Its capacity is roughly 2.5x the Class A market value at $1.00, and the same agent sold an identical $20m facility to completion between 2026-02-27 and 2026-06-16, through two reverse splits.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration (F-3 333-297406) is effective and the prospectus supplement was filed 2026-10-05, so sales can occur any session including 10-08. A foreign private issuer files no per-sale notice, so the supply arrives as tape flow rather than as a document.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: During and after the prior ATM, this name logged consecutive large falls: 2026-06-24 -19.25% then -26.16% the next day; 2026-08-27 -9.91% then -18.85%, then -14.84%. Over the baseline's 83 comparable falls the median next close is -1.84% and the up rate 34.9%. The 2026-10-06 fall (-18.12%) has already been followed by today's -11.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the announcement but not the flow. An ATM is sold over sessions, and at about $0.22m of turnover today against $20m of capacity the selling cannot be spent. If the price held the full supply, the stock would sit near a level at which the agent stops selling. Nothing documents such a level: the agent has no price floor in the agreement, and the company is not obliged to stop.
findings.independence: The company's own record of the prior ATM: 6-K of 2026-06-16 reporting completion at 93.9m shares (post the 1:50 split) for about $20m gross. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1985337/000118518526002531/yygh6k061626.htm

outside_window.finding: The stock is at $1.00, after reverse splits of 1:50 (2026-03-23) and 1:30 (2026-06-23) and a prior Nasdaq bid-price deficiency (notice 2025-10-21, compliance regained 2026-04-15). A renewed bid-price deficiency needs 30 consecutive business days below $1, and a third reverse split needs a board or shareholder process. Both resolve weeks out.
Overhang of 3,787,379 Class A shares (48.33%) issued to Yinan Ren on 2026-08-03 as Xtreme Solution consideration. The 424B5 flags their possible sale as a risk. No lock-up expiry date was found.
Use of proceeds includes repaying the Ault Lending convertible note (US$1.37m) by 2026-12-31 and a 25%-interest Bizcap loan (about US$0.64m). This is a liquidity need that keeps the ATM selling.
